payload.claim: This except clause now wraps two different cells: `run_history`'s own Gate-only cell (opened at the new call just above, inside the same `try`) and the lens critic cell opened by the `with critic_cell(...)` a few lines below. Before this diff the clause wrapped only the lens cell, so `rejected.reason("the critic cell")` was accurate; now a patch rejected inside `run_history`'s Gate-only cell (test case 4, 'history-cell-refused') produces the same message, wrongly naming it 'the critic cell' when CONTEXT.md draws that distinction on purpose ('It is not the critic cell, and the distinction is the point.'). The phase-start detail an operator reads to diagnose an EXHAUSTED task now misreports which cell refused the patch.
